tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow (manual #f6e71a). The logo mark on navy and blue, accent fills: the secondary CTA, the active-nav dot, highlight chips. Never as text or icon on light surfaces (fails contrast); text on it is `on-yellow`.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy (manual #2d2d45). Primary CTA fill, dark bands and footer, the logo on yellow. Text on it is `on-navy`.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Brand blue (manual #4d72a6). The wordmark on navy, links, info states and icon accents on light surfaces (in the dark theme use `link` for icons and text). Text on a blue fill is `on-blue`.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything (the reference's soft grey; warm like the manual's paper). Hero sits directly on it.

tokens.name: surface-paper
tokens.usage: The manual's paper grey. Image tiles with no photo, inset wells, the hover of quiet controls.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the big rounded section container, service cards, the stat chip, the tracking card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body copy on `surface-page`, `surface-paper` and `surface-card`. Navy, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: ledes, card bullets, feature captions, nav links, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: ONLY for display text 24px+: the muted second line of a two-tone headline ("…con inteligencia"). 3:1 on `surface-page` and `surface-card`; never for body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section dividers, card borders on `surface-page`, list rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline-button and input borders (3:1 on `surface-card`); also the dashed track in the tracking timeline.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill ("Solicitar demo"). Navy on light, yellow on dark. Text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and arrow on an `action` fill.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on a `navy` fill (both themes).

tokens.name: on-yellow
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `yellow` fill.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on a `blue` fill (4.8:1; keep it 14px bold or larger).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline text links and the "Ver todos →" section link on light surfaces; a darker step of `blue` so it passes 4.5:1 on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset on every interactive element.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status 'Entregado' — always paired with the word and a check icon.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Status 'Demorado' chip fill — text on it is `on-yellow`; always paired with the word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status 'Incidencia' and form errors — always paired with the word and an icon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, max 4 short lines; the last line(s) in `ink-subtle`.

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: Gotham Light Italic: optional accent words inside a display or h1 headline. Never a whole paragraph.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The value in a stat chip or KPI.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Back office, rastreo de envíos y análisis de datos para empresas de logística.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero or section title, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Nos encargamos de la operación para que tu equipo se enfoque en crecer.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Card bullets, nav links, contact line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Feature-row captions, meta lines, form hints.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title. Set in uppercase via CSS; write the copy in sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons, between bullets.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a feature icon and its caption; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Service-card padding; grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between a title and its body; hero column gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section-container padding; gap between section header and grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks inside one section container.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of the hero and of full-width bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small chips, status badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Image tiles inside cards, the tracking card's inner wells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Service cards, image tiles, stat chip, tracking card.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The big section container that overlaps the hero.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, icon button and nav CTA: Intello buttons are always pills or circles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `surface-page`.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Elements that float over imagery: the stat chip, the hero tracking card.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; page side padding is `space-6` (desktop) / `space-4` (mobile).

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top navigation bar.
